name: Zenith Exports Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1969, Zenith Exports Ltd is in the business of Leather Goods & Textile Fabrics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures textile products for the fashion and home furnishing industries. It has established manufacturing units to cater to handcrafted and automated fabrication sectors

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.73% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.56% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.8.86 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 69.2 to 89.1 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -6.21%
